title: Customer Account Administrator
description:
Customer Account Administrator

Location: Chester

We are working with a well-established and growing organisation to recruit a Customer Account Administrator. This is a busy and varied role combining high-volume sales order administration, internal account management support, and day-to-day coordination of B2 B customer requirements.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will help ensure accounts run smoothly, orders are processed accurately, and customers receive timely updates from order receipt through to delivery.

The role would suit a highly organised administrator with experience in sales support, customer account coordination, or B2 B order processing who enjoys taking ownership of customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Administering the full sales order lifecycle, processing high volumes of B2 B customer orders from receipt through to delivery
- Providing internal account management support to key customers, handling order changes, amendments, and ongoing requirements
- Maintaining regular customer contact, providing updates and responding to order and delivery enquiries
- Processing customer forecasts and demand plans using MS Excel and SAP
- Producing and maintaining 13-week rolling forecast reports to support demand and capacity planning
- Liaising with supply chain, production, logistics, and sales teams to resolve order shortfalls and capacity constraints
- Creating and maintaining shortage lists, identifying material and stock issues and coordinating their resolution
- Managing stock control and inventory records, supporting clear stock management to prevent obsolete stock
- Ensuring all orders are entered accurately into internal systems, with a high level of attention to detail
- Maintaining customer master data and undertaking system updates to keep customer and order information accurate
- Supporting and actively participating in weekly, monthly, and quarterly demand review meetings with customers and internal stakeholders
- Recording incoming orders and daily customer call-offs within automated systems
- Proactively managing customer requirements and expectations, ensuring alignment with demand, capacity, and production plans
- Supporting continuous improvement across administrative processes and customer engagement
- Providing ad hoc administrative support as required

Candidate Requirements
- Proven experience in a busy administration, sales support, B2 B customer service, or customer account support role involving high-volume order processing
- Experience within manufacturing and/or logistics would be highly advantageous
- Strong working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel
- SAP experience desirable but not essential
- Confident communication skills and experience liaising with B2 B customers and internal departments
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and accurate data entry skills
- Able to manage multiple customer requirements and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Proactive and self-motivated, with the initiative to follow up queries and coordinate solutions

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance

We re looking for a proactive and practical Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance to support the running and ongoing development of waste and recycling sites.

Salary £35-40k plus mileage

Location: North West You may be based in Chester, Buckley, Mold, Wrexham and surrounding areas.

There will be regular travel between company sites

About the Role

Working closely with the General Manager and key department leads, you ll play a central role in coordinating logistics, improving operational efficiency, managing site projects, monitoring costs and supporting high standards of environmental, health and safety compliance.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining project coordination and planning with practical involvement in site operations. From coordinating container loading and material movements to overseeing machinery installations, facility improvements and safety actions, you ll help ensure our sites operate safely, efficiently and cost-effectively.

You may have been - Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, Operations Project Coordinator, Operations Manager, Project Manager, Site Coordinator, Site Operations Coordinator, Business Operations Coordinator, Operational Support Coordinator, Environmental Compliance Coordinator, Health & Safety Coordinator, EHS Coordinator, SHEQ Coordinator, HSEQ Coordinator

Key Responsibilities as a Project Coordinator:

Operations & Logistics
- Coordinate daily workflows, collections, deliveries and processing schedules across three sites.
- Work closely with warehouse, administration, engineering and compliance teams to maintain efficient material flow.

Project & Facilities Coordination
- Coordinate projects from planning through to completion, including site upgrades, machinery installations and new recycling processes.
- Monitor facility, maintenance and equipment costs, helping keep projects and site improvements within budget.

Compliance, Health & Safety
- Support the Compliance & H&S Manager in maintaining environmental, hazardous waste and workplace safety standards.
- Coordinate site inspections, risk assessments, fire drills and toolbox talks.
- Maintain accurate safety records, track incidents and near misses, and follow up on corrective actions.

Reporting & Cost Control
- Monitor key performance indicators, including tonnage processed and recovery rates.
- Reconcile contractor, maintenance, safety equipment and logistics invoices before management approval.
- Prepare weekly operational, safety and project updates for the General Manager.

About You:

You ll ideally have:
- At least 3 years experience in project coordination, operations or operational support within an industrial, recycling, waste management or logistics environment.
- Experience coordinating workflows, schedules, goods movements or activities across multiple sites.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with confidence in reporting, data tracking and basic budget reconciliation.
- An understanding of workplace health and safety, environmental compliance and hazardous waste handling.
- Experience monitoring facility costs, maintenance expenditure or project budgets.
- A full, clean UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly between our three sites.

Experience with inventory or operational management software would be an advantage.

description:

Company Overview:

We are seeking an organised and detail-oriented Purchase Ledger Assistant to support a busy finance department based in the Winsford area.

The ideal candidate will be a reliable addition to the Finance Team and will be responsible for maintaining an accurate purchase ledger, processing payments and ensuring smooth communication between internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities for our Purchase Ledger Assistant:
- Transaction Operations: Keep financial engines running smoothly by meticulously managing the purchase ledger and ensuring all AP data is accurate and current
- Statement Reconciliation: Perform regular reconciliations of supplier statements against internal records, investigating any discrepancies
- GRNI Reconciliation: Actively monitor and reconcile the Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) account, investigating aging purchase orders and unmatched receipts to ensure accurate inventory valuations
- Payment Processing: Process supplier payments accurately and on time
- Query Resolution: Serve as a point of contact for purchase ledger queries, actively liaising with internal departments, suppliers and service providers to resolve issues
- Reporting: Generate and distribute weekly and monthly reports for the management team
- General Administration: Answer incoming calls, directing them to the appropriate team members or handling baseline financial inquiries
- Ad-hoc Duties: Undertake additional administrative and financial tasks as required to support the wider department

Essential Skills and Experience Required for our Purchase Ledger Assistant:
- Experience: Proven experience in a Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable, or similar finance administration role
- Qualifications: AAT qualified, or actively studying towards an AAT qualification (Level 2 or above), is highly preferred
- Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Oracle NetSuite is required and must be comfortable and efficient working within a paperless, cloud-based accounting environment
- Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Accounts Payable lifecycle, including purchase order matching and GRNI (Goods Received Not Invoiced) reconciliations
- Attention to Detail: Meticulous accuracy when processing data, auditing purchase orders and reconciling complex supplier statements
- Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to professionally liaise with suppliers, service providers and internal management to resolve disputes Organisation & Time Management: Strong ability to multitask, manage high-volume workloads and consistently meet weekly reporting and payment deadlines

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 37.75 hours per week, office-based
